description: This file defines data structures and functions for managing virtual network configurations in Windows, including network creation, modification, deletion, and querying, specifically for Hyper-V or Windows networking using HNS API.

classes.name: HostComputeNetwork
classes.description: Represents a virtual network with properties like ID, name, type, policies, IPAM, DNS, flags, health, and schema version.

classes.name: SubnetFlags
classes.description: Flags that can be set on a subnet, such as DoNotReserveGatewayAddress.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a route associated with a subnet, including next hop, destination prefix, and metric.

classes.name: Subnet
classes.description: Defines a subnet with IP prefix, policies, routes, and flags.

classes.name: Ipam
classes.description: Internet Protocol Address Management configuration with type and subnets.

classes.name: MacRange
classes.description: Start and end MAC addresses for a MacPool.

classes.name: Dns
classes.description: DNS configuration including domain, search list, server list, and options.

classes.name: NetworkType
classes.description: Enumeration of network types such as NAT, Transparent, L2Bridge, etc.

classes.name: NetworkFlags
classes.description: Flags for network configuration such as None, EnableNonPersistent, DisableHostPort, EnableIov.

classes.name: NetworkResourceType
classes.description: Types of network resource settings: Policy, DNS, Extension.

classes.name: ModifyNetworkSettingRequest
classes.description: Request structure for modifying network settings, including resource type, request type, and settings payload.

methods.name: getNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves a network by GUID and query, returning a HostComputeNetwork object.

methods.name: enumerateNetworks
methods.description: Enumerates all networks matching a query, returning a list of HostComputeNetwork objects.

methods.name: createNetwork
methods.description: Creates a new network with specified settings and returns the created HostComputeNetwork.

methods.name: modifyNetwork
methods.description: Modifies an existing network identified by ID with new settings.

methods.name: ListNetworksQuery
methods.description: Lists networks based on a specific query.

methods.name: GetNetworkByID
methods.description: Retrieves a network by its ID.

methods.name: GetNetworkByName
methods.description: Retrieves a network by its name.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the network resource in the system.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the network resource from the system.

methods.name: ModifyNetworkSettings
methods.description: Updates network settings such as policies.

methods.name: AddPolicy
methods.description: Adds a policy to the network.

methods.name: RemovePolicy
methods.description: Removes a policy from the network.

methods.name: CreateEndpoint
methods.description: Creates an endpoint on the network.

methods.name: CreateRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a remote endpoint on the network.
